description: Represents an embedded figure as ONE figure block: a photo/image, chart, plot, diagram, illustration, logo, seal, or map — anything non-text that occupies a region.
applicability: The region contains an embedded image/figure (in OCR HTML an tag; in markdown an ![...]() image), a chart/plot, a diagram, or an illustration.
The figure may have a caption nearby.
instructions: Emit each figure as ONE block of block_type figure, holding a short description of what it depicts. Its bounding box is provided separately by the OCR layout — do NOT invent coordinates.
Keep the figure as a PLACEHOLDER in reading order at its position on the page; do NOT transcribe a figure as body text and never silently drop it.
If the figure has a caption, keep the caption as its own caption block; you may attach the caption to the figure via parent_block_id.
A chart/diagram is a figure, not a table — only a populated row/column grid is a table.

provenance.reason: General-document adaptation (MPDocBench): renamed image_or_seal -> figure and generalized to any figure/chart/diagram; figure boxes come from the OCR layer while the LLM emits a reading-order placeholder.
